description: THE tool for "I wrote the part, now play it": a doseedo instrument model performs the MIDI you give it — your exact notes, in your key, at your bpm — and returns audio takes. This is how an agent makes AI audio of a specific part (prompt-only doseedo_generate_music cannot take notes or a key). Input ONE of: notes[] ({pitch, start_beats, duration_beats, velocity} — beats from bar 1, the same rows as doseedo_edit_session set_midi_notes), midi_url (a .mid ≤2 MiB: a doseedo result link or a public https URL), or session_id + track_id (that track's notes are read from the session summary). Required: instrument (an id from GET https://api.doseedo.com/api/instruments, open; each lists its playable range — stay inside it) and bpm. The notes are sent AS GIVEN — no pitch snapping, no quantizing. One voice per part: a chord part is rendered one voice per output with voice_split:true (result.voices maps each voice to its files and notes). takes (1–4) fixes the number of takes; omitted, the server picks best-of-N for the part length and returns them best-first (takes[0] = the scorer's winner). Async: returns a job_id — poll with doseedo_wait_task (~1–3 minutes). Result: takes[{url, rank, score}] (pre-signed: curl -OJ, no auth header, 24 h), seed (pass it back to re-render close to the same take), duration, voices?, refine?, chain. A take may miss or change a note — verify by listening or by doseedo_transcribe on a take (then compare pitches/onsets to what you sent); offer the user the takes rather than promising note-perfection. To check the harmony of the notes BEFORE spending credits use doseedo_analyze_midi. Cancel: a render that has not reached the GPU yet is stopped and its credits refunded; one already rendering finishes on the GPU (its credits are spent), the job ends as canceled and the output is discarded.

bpm.description: REQUIRED. Tempo of the notes (10–400). Written into the MIDI's tempo meta, so start_beats/duration_beats land at exactly this tempo.

duration_seconds.description: Length of the render in seconds (0.01–600). Default: the last note's end + 2 s of release. Each 30 s window costs 10 credits.

dynamics.description: Target dynamic for the timbre pick: "pp", "p", "mp", "mf", "f", "ff", "fff", a 0–1 number, or a MIDI velocity as text.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for THIS request (e.g. a UUID). Re-sending the same call with the same key after a timeout returns the same job instead of starting a second one.

instrument.description: REQUIRED. Instrument id from GET https://api.doseedo.com/api/instruments (e.g. "violin", "tenor_sax", "electric_guitar", "piano"). Keep the notes inside its range.

midi_url.description: Alternative to notes: https URL of a Standard MIDI File (≤2 MiB) — a doseedo result link (a stem's MIDI) or a public URL. Its own tempo map is used by the model; bpm still tags the caption and sizes the default duration.

notes.description: The part, as note rows in beats from bar 1 (beat 0 = bar 1 beat 1, quarter-note beats at `bpm`). Monophonic for one voice; chords need voice_split:true. Up to 4096 notes.

prompt.description: Optional caption override (default: the instrument id). Style words help a little; the notes are the control.

refine.description: Opt-in post-render correction. "light": attacks re-timed onto the score, exposed wrong pitch classes re-pitched inside the played octave, misfires muted (winds/brass/strings). "shred": play exactly the written line, octave included, mute anything the score never wrote (any pitched mono part). The raw render stays downloadable (result.refine.raw_url).

seed.description: Random seed (−1 or 0–4294967295). Reuse a result's seed to re-render close to the same take.

session_id.description: Alternative to notes: with track_id, render THAT session track's notes (read from doseedo_get_session's summary).

takes.description: How many takes to render, 1–4 (one GPU batch; no extra credits). Omit to let the server choose best-of-N for the part length.

timbre_audio_url.description: https URL of a short recording (≤24 MB; its first 30 s are used) whose SOUND the render should take on — a doseedo result link or a public URL.

timbre_preset.description: A named timbre preset for the instrument (the catalog's preset ids). Omit for the instrument default.

time_signature.description: Meter of the part, e.g. "4/4", "3/4", "6/8" (default 4/4). Written into the MIDI and the caption.

track_id.description: With session_id: the t_… id of the MIDI/instrument track to render.

voice_split.description: true = the notes hold chords: split them into the voices one player of this instrument can hold and render every voice (result.voices). Default false (a chord in a mono part is an error the model will fudge).

name: doseedo_render_midi
